Management Comments

"The Company remains focused on advancing the development of Thykamine™ and unlocking its full therapeutic and commercial potential, with the objective of maximizing long-term shareholder value. To support this strategy, the Company is actively pursuing various financing alternatives, including private placements and a potential listing on a U.S. stock exchange, to secure the capital necessary to advance its development programs, achieve key strategic milestones and capitalize on business development opportunities."  said Dr. André P. Boulet, President and Chief Executive Officer of Devonian.
Financial Highlights
(all amounts are in Canadian dollars)
Quarter ended July 31, 2026

For the three-month period ended July 31, 2026, the Company reported a net loss of $625,925, or $0.23 per share, compared to a net loss of $374,964, or $0.15 per share, for the corresponding period in 2025. The year-over-year increase in net loss was primarily attributable to lower gross margins generated by the pharmaceutical distribution activities of the Company's subsidiary, Altius Healthcare Group LP ("Altius"), primarily reflecting the expiration and non-renewal of the Pantoprazole Magnesium distribution agreement, as well as a decrease in interest income. These factors were partially offset by lower selling and administrative expenses and an increase in refundable R&D tax credits recognized during the quarter.

Distribution revenues for the fourth quarter amounted to $74 thousand, compared to $1.3 million for the corresponding period of the previous fiscal year. This decrease was primarily attributable to the previously announced expiration and non-renewal of the Pantoprazole Magnesium distribution agreement in April 2026, which significantly reduced revenues from the Company's pharmaceutical distribution activities through its Altius division.
Fiscal Year ended July 31, 2026

For the twelve-month period ended July 31, 2026, the Company recorded a net loss of $6.4 million, or $2.30 per share, compared to a net loss of $6.0 million, or $2.43 per share, for the corresponding period in 2025. While the net loss for fiscal 2026 increased slightly compared to the previous fiscal year, the net loss per share decreased.

The year-over-year increase in net loss was primarily attributable to a $5.4 million increase in loss from operations and a $0.2 million decrease in interest income. These increases were partially offset by the absence of $4.8 million in non-cash, non-recurring impairment charges recognized in the previous fiscal year, comprising a $4.6 million goodwill impairment and a $0.2 million intellectual property impairment, both directly related to the Altius pharmaceutical distribution business, as well as a $0.4 million decrease in income tax expense.

For the fiscal year ended July 31, 2026, distribution revenues amounted to $1.8 million, compared to $23.6 million in the previous fiscal year. This year-over-year decrease was primarily attributable to the expiration of the licensing agreements for the distribution of Pantoprazole Magnesium and Dexlansoprazole. The Company continues to distribute Cléo-35® through its Altius division and remains committed to rebuilding its sales, while maintaining its primary strategic focus on advancing the development of Thykamine™ and unlocking its full therapeutic and commercial potential.

For the fiscal year ended July 31, 2026, research and development expenses, net of refundable R&D tax credits, amounted to $0.9 million, compared to $2.0 million for the previous fiscal year. This decrease is primarily attributable to the implementation of cost-control measures, disciplined resource allocation, and the strategic planning and phased execution of activities related to the Thykamine™ Phase II/III clinical study in pediatric atopic dermatitis and the clinical study for the prevention of radiodermatitis. The Company also continued to advance preclinical studies supporting potential new therapeutic applications of Thykamine™, while optimizing research expenditures and benefiting from refundable R&D tax credits.
Cash position and financing

As of July 31, 2026, the Company had cash and cash equivalents of $0.2 million, compared to $7.0 million as of July 31, 2025. During the twelve-month period ended July 31, 2026, the Company used $8.9 million in cash for operating activities. These cash outflows were partially offset by financing proceeds of $2.0 million from two private placements completed during the first quarter of fiscal 2026 and an additional $0.1 million generated through the exercise of subscription warrants during the third quarter of fiscal 2026.

About Thykamine™

Thykamine™, the first pharmaceutical product issued from Devonian's SUPREX™ platform, is a highly innovative product for the prevention and treatment of health conditions related to inflammation and oxidative stress including ulcerative colitis, atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, rheumatoid arthritis, and other autoimmune disorders. The anti-inflammatory, anti-oxidative and immunomodulatory properties of Thykamine™ have been demonstrated by a considerable number of in vitro and in vivo studies as well as in a Phase IIa clinical study in patients with mild-to-moderate distal ulcerative colitis and in a large Phase II study in adult patients with mild-to-moderate Atopic Dermatitis. The Thykamine™ and SUPREX™ technology platforms are supported by a patent portfolio with issued patents spanning key markets in North America, Europe, and Asia.
About Devonian

Devonian Health Group Inc. is a clinical late-stage pharmaceutical company specializing in the development of drugs for various auto-immune fibroinflammatory disease with novel therapeutic approaches to targeting unmet medical needs. Devonian's core strategy is to develop prescription drugs for the treatment of fibroinflammatory autoimmune diseases including but not limited to atopic dermatitis, radiodermatitis and ulcerative colitis.
Devonian Health Group Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Quebec, Canada where it owns a state-of-the-art extraction facility. Devonian is traded publicly on the TSXV (
) and currently quoted on the OTCQB Venture Market (OTCQB: DVHGF).
